faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.finishedAnswer: No, this site is a work in progress and continuously being improved.
faq.aboutAnswer: AdondeVamos is a travel planning platform where you can discover places, create trips, and share your travel experiences with a community of explorers.
faq.freeAnswer: Yes! AdondeVamos is completely free. You can browse places, create trips, and share your adventures without any cost.
faq.accountQuestion: Do I need an account to use the site?
faq.accountAnswer: You can browse trips and places without an account, but to create your own content, vote on places, or save favorites, you'll need to register.
faq.createTripQuestion: How do I create a trip?
faq.createTripAnswer: Click on Trips in the navigation bar, then click the Create Trip button. Fill in your trip details including name, dates, description, and add places to your itinerary.
faq.editTripQuestion: Can I edit my trip after creating it?
faq.editTripAnswer: Yes! You can edit your trips at any time. Just go to your trip and click the edit button. You can modify dates, add or remove places, and update the description.
faq.itineraryQuestion: How do I add places to my trip itinerary?
faq.itineraryAnswer: When creating or editing a trip, you can search for places and add them to your itinerary. You can also set specific dates for each place visit.
faq.shareTripQuestion: Can I share my trip with others?
faq.shareTripAnswer: Absolutely! Each trip has a share button that lets you copy the link or share directly through social media. Your friends can view your trip even without an account.
faq.addPlaceQuestion: How do I add a new place?
faq.addPlaceAnswer: Navigate to Places and click Create Place. Fill in the details including name, location, description, facilities, and upload photos to help others discover this location.
faq.photosQuestion: Can I upload photos to places?
faq.photosAnswer: Yes! When creating or editing a place, you can upload multiple photos to showcase the location. High-quality images help other travelers get a better sense of the place.
faq.facilitiesAnswer: Facilities are amenities or features available at a location, such as parking, WiFi, restaurants, accessibility features, etc. These help travelers know what to expect.
faq.votingQuestion: How does the voting system work?
faq.votingAnswer: Registered users can vote on places they like. The most voted places appear in the Most Voted Places section, helping others discover popular destinations.
faq.createAccountQuestion: How do I create an account?
faq.createAccountAnswer: Click Login in the navigation bar, then select Sign Up. Enter your email, create a username, and set a secure password to get started.
faq.pageDescription: Frequently asked questions about AdondeVamos — trips, places, accounts and more.
